ValidationRule.description: Ensures that records with a Chain or Regulator reference have either a Legal Form or VAT ID. Evaluated only on create or when relevant fields change. Only populated references are checked, and Account Classification bypass records are excluded.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_AccountClassificationVRs), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(ConditionChainParent__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(ConditionChainHead__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(CentralRegulator__c)) ), ISBLANK(TEXT(LegalForm__c)), ISBLANK(TaxID__c), OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(LegalForm__c), ISCHANGED(TaxID__c), ISCHANGED(ConditionChainParent__c), ISCHANGED(ConditionChainHead__c), ISCHANGED(CentralRegulator__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please answer the legal-entity question: accounts in a chain structure require a legal form (or the explicit value ‚No legal entity status‘) or their own VAT ID.
